analogs.covers: Group and prey: gangs of 'river wolves' that hunt on land and in water and kill caimans
Temper: ferocious far above its weight, possessive, a hoarder that holds grudges

headline: A gang of giant otters, the 'river wolves' that kill crocodiles, with a stoat's ferocity and a hoarder's temper.

setting.label: Rivers, marshes and shores
setting.note: Semi-aquatic and sedentary; uses water to its advantage in every situation. Stashes trinkets in caverns or dug-out holes along shores and marshes, and nests communally at its marsh nesting ground.

playsLike: You are a swift, medium semi-aquatic carnivore in a leaderless gang of up to 8. Solo you hunt up to Medium tier, 2–3 of you up to Large, and a full party of 4 takes solo Apex prey (never sauropods). Your favourite targets are Sarcosuchus, Deinosuchus and Megalania. Near water you may third-party any hunt, and you rip prey apart within minutes. You are possessive, you hold grudges, and nobody touches your trinkets.

why.text: Preferred prey is solitary or paired Sarcosuchus, solitary Deinosuchus and Megalania. Giant otters hunt caimans (official inspiration).
Up to 8 adults with no fixed leader, following the most experienced. Giant-otter groups are about that size.
May third-party any hunt that comes within 2 body lengths of its water and uses the water to escape or attack.
Only 2,100 combat weight, yet 4 take down solo Apex animals, and its brutal feeding strips prey fast. That is stoat ferocity (official inspiration).
Collects and stashes trinkets and attacks anyone who steals them. Grudges against rivals never fade.

notLike: Giant otters are close family groups; Concavenator gangs are loose and selfish.
Stoats are solitary, while Concavenator hunts as a team.
